summary: Recovered the predecessor's PARTIAL contract instead of rebuilding it. Verified that Primary Chat now has a deterministic runtime binding in progress-v1.js plus a runtime binding harness, then completed the remaining reusable contract surface with a derived daily autonomy/time projection, E0-E9-compatible step telemetry normalization, explicit execution-depth taxonomy, and missing-telemetry boundaries. All additions remain NON_AUTHORITATIVE_DERIVED_PROJECTION and prohibit inference of missing provider/internal compute data.

tests.name: completion clause assertions
tests.detail: Executed deterministic assertions for 14 daily projection fields, human_routing_actions target=0, six execution-depth classes, derived-only authority, UNKNOWN_NOT_INFERRED missing events, and no second telemetry ledger.

missing_telemetry_that_truly_requires_in: FIRST_MATERIAL_WRITE when no durable timestamp exists
FANIN_STARTED when only final integration receipt exists
JUDGED when no explicit Judge/verification record exists
explicit_boundaries: Provider compute depth is not derived from worker counts/UI cards.
Model internal passes/private reasoning are never reconstructed.
Raw/private audio, transcript and credentials stay outside public projection.
No scheduler, liveness, Current, acceptance or telemetry authority was created.
